guideline_findings: musaf_malkhuyot_close (s210): the parenthesised (מלכנו) marks a word some say and others omit. Per JLPTEI-3 §Bible/alternates ('Text that some communities add and others omit is a condition, not an alternate'), it should be a j:conditional on an opensiddur:variant condition URN (for example urn:x-opensiddur:condition:prayer:amidah/melokh_al_kol_haolam/malkenu), keeping the printed unpointed word. It should not be a tei:choice of j:option 'וּדְבָרְךָ' / 'וּדְבָרְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ', which also repeats וּדְבָרְךָ inside both options.

Instruction notes (musaf_yismechu, and the two in musaf_malkhuyot_close) must transcribe the rubric as printed, pointing included. See the corrections. The placement as the j:conditional's own tei:note is correct per §Instructions.

The rite alternative is structured correctly: musaf_offering_formula/ushenei_seirim is conditioned frankfurt_am_main=false, and musaf_useir_lekhapper is conditioned true with its printed abbreviated rubric. No structural change needed.
